references.text: The burnt offering shall be a bull from the cattle, as prescribed in the sacrificial laws of Leviticus
The ram as a burnt offering is mentioned here as an acceptable offering from the small livestock
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering is specified in the sacrificial regulations
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering is mentioned in connection with the purification offering
The same offering was brought by Nahshon on the first day, showing the pattern of the tribal leaders' gifts
Netanel from Issachar brought an identical burnt offering, confirming the equality among the tribes
Young bulls, rams, and one-year-old lambs for a burnt offering at the New Moon festival
One-year-old lambs as the daily burnt offering on the altar
